source.snippet: I wanted to harden server-side validation for file uploads in Apex, but I haven't found much articles or established patterns for this. Context: I have a REST endpoint that accepts a file name and the file's Blob data directly in the request body. This endpoint is exposed to guest users through an Experience Cloud site. This logic is part of a managed package, so I don't control the end customer's org configuration.

problem_statement: Salesforce ISV developers building managed packages with file upload endpoints exposed to guest users lack established patterns or tooling for server-side file validation and security hardening in Apex.
target_segment: Salesforce ISV developers and AppExchange managed package authors building customer-facing Experience Cloud applications
notes: ISV/managed package context implies commercial product being sold on AppExchange — clear paying-builder context. Security hardening tooling or code templates for Salesforce devs is a niche but monetizable category (existing players: Salesforce Security Review consultants charging $5-20k). Single signal but domain-specific gap.
